name: mageroot
note: Mageroot (the item mana_herb, its id kept): near water (docs/39 section 4, Herbalism 4); named by Michael, 2026-10-25: "Mana herb is Mageroot for now". Grows like a weed at random on natural ground and comes back elsewhere once gathered (docs/46, src/resources.js); gathered by hand (src/gather.js). Drawn art: art round 5 (the herbs), the node and the item from one design.
